newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka eases at close on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka eases at close on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed easier at 42.5490/5495 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous 42.5470/5490, dealers said.
Dealers said the local unit was quoted at 42.5475/5490 per dollar in early trade, but fell later on higher demand from importers.
"The market had no major activity. Import payments appear to have slowed down a bit in recent days," said one dealer.
Dealers said there was brisk trade in the call money market with the rates quoting at 5.5 percent to 6.0 percent against the previous 5.0-6.0 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
